svg.aria-label: BCBC 2024 Article 9.23.6.2 Anchorage of Columns and Posts
svg.title: BCBC 2024 · 9.23.6.2 Anchorage of Columns and Posts
svg.text: BCBC 2024 · DIVISION B · PART 9 HOUSING AND SMALL BUILDINGS · SECTION 9.23 WOOD-FRAME CONSTRUCTION
Anchorage of Columns and Posts

g.text: Exterior post anchored to resist uplift
Low platform: posts anchored to the
foundation, or framing anchored to the ground, (2)
1 storey, 55 m² or less, no roof, not

svg.text: WHAT THE CODE REQUIRES
Except as provided in Sentences (2) and (3),
exterior columns and posts are anchored to
resist uplift and lateral movement.
Except as provided in Sentence (3), where
columns or posts support balconies, decks,
verandas or other exterior platforms, and
finished ground to the underside of the joists
is not more than 600 mm,
(a) the columns or posts are anchored to the
foundation to resist uplift and lateral movement,
or (b) the supported joists or beams are directly
anchored to the ground to resist uplift.
Anchorage is not required for these platforms
where they
(a) are not more than 1 storey in height, (b) are
not more than 55 m² in area, (c) do not support a
roof, and (d) are not attached to another
structure, unless differential movement can be
shown not to affect the performance of the
structure it is attached to.
Drawn: generic galvanized post bases, no make or model. Finished ground taken at the top of the footings. Deck sizes are illustration only.
Source: BCBC 2024, Division B, Article 9.23.6.2. (page 9-177)
